interpretation: Descriptive single-seed paired reward-curriculum experiment on two maps, not statistical superiority. The arms differ in coefficient timing AND coefficient-step mass; realized penalty depends on visited states. Both arms preserve the same raw contact reward, parent, sensors and inference. Comparisons against the frozen parent are required: beating a degraded immediate arm is insufficient. The separate 64s secondary cannot override the 16s primary. No automatic promotion or physical-robot safety claim.
